# devin_enterprise_knowledge_folders (Data Source)

Lists the enterprise's knowledge folders. Devin has no API for creating, renaming, or deleting knowledge folders, so folders are created in the Devin UI and referenced from Terraform. Note that devin_enterprise_knowledge_note does not accept a folder_id — the enterprise notes endpoint rejects it — so this data source is for inspecting the enterprise tree; use devin_knowledge_folders to place org-level notes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Enterprise-level knowledge folders. Note that devin_enterprise_knowledge_note
# does not accept a folder_id — the enterprise notes endpoint rejects it — so
# this data source is for inspecting the enterprise tree. Use
# devin_knowledge_folders to place org-level notes.
data "devin_enterprise_knowledge_folders" "all" {}

output "enterprise_knowledge_folders" {
  value = {
    for f in data.devin_enterprise_knowledge_folders.all.folders : f.path => f.note_count
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `folders` (Attributes List) Knowledge folders in the enterprise, as a flat list of the full folder tree. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--folders))
- `root_note_count` (Number) Number of knowledge notes at the root, i.e. not in any folder.

<a id="nestedatt--folders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `folders`

Read-Only:

- `folder_id` (String) Folder ID, as accepted by devin_knowledge_note.folder_id.
- `name` (String) Folder name.
- `note_count` (Number) Number of knowledge notes directly in this folder.
- `parent_folder_id` (String) ID of the parent folder, or null for a top-level folder.
- `path` (String) Full path of the folder within the tree, e.g. 'Backend/Conventions'.
